value: RtfMRI significantly increased the percentage of positive trials when comparing the last with the first training run in the experimental group, whereas the control group showed no improvement. These results indicated that participants learned to improve their performance in the presence of feedback.

spans.text: Results indicated that rtfMRI-nf significantly increased the percentage of positive trials when comparing last with first training (mean difference = 8.2 %, SEM = 2.4 %, t (Sarkheil et al. 2015 ) = 3.5, p = 0.007). However, CG did not show any improvement (mean difference = −0.9 %, SEM = 1.4 %, t (Young et al. 2014 ) = −0.67, p = 0.52).
